title: 26 U.S.C. 460, Special rules for long-term contracts (U.S. Code 2024 edition, before P.L. 119-21)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, United States Code

passages.question: Were any home sales under a long-term contract?
passages.excerpt: The term "long-term contract" means any contract for the manufacture, building, installation, or construction of property if such contract is not completed within the taxable year in which such contract is entered into.
